title: Founder / Head of Technology
excerpt: Co-founded a mobile creative studio serving luxury brands across Asia Pacific. Sold the first $1M in services and built one of the first enterprise iOS apps, for Standard Chartered Bank.
html:
Co-founded a mobile creative studio in Shanghai serving luxury brands across Asia Pacific, and sold its first $1M in services with early clients including FrogDesign, Nortel, and Standard Chartered Bank.

Notable builds

  • The first enterprise iOS application of its kind — an HR mobile app for Standard Chartered Bank in Singapore
  • A custom Microsoft Outlook plugin for Nortel R&D, integrating Nortel's unified communications stack across voice, text, voicemail, fax, and presence

Set the company's technical direction toward enterprise mobile software and established its code quality practice.
